The implementation is complete. Summary of the delivered service in `/workspace/submission`:

**Structure** (9 files, 128.6 KB — within the 256-entry / 1 MiB budgets, no special files):
- **`main.py`** — process entry: JSON-lines loop under `-I -B`, explicit script-dir `sys.path` for local imports, flushes one reply per line, never terminates on malformed input.
- **`wire.py`** — strict JSON decoding (duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity rejected).
- **`schema.py`** — exact-field schema validation: JSON-integer strictness (bools/decimals/exponents rejected), ASCII `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,32}` IDs, all ranges (ticks, periods, refs [0,47]/[0,127], envelope/booking/participant limits), window/envelope semantics.
- **`service.py`** — the persistent controller: `load` (first-load structural overbooking → invalid, later loads → `ALREADY_LOADED`), `about`, `audit`, `advance` (expiry at `end<=t`), `edit` (stale→REFERENCE→blocked witness→force-revocation semantics), `prepare` (load-id/different-payload `CONFLICT`, exact-payload `replay` with `base_rev`/`outcome`, priority stale→REFERENCE→TIME→WINDOW, failures retriable), `commit` (MISSING→OWNER→replay→GONE→DENIED→stale/base-rev), `cancel` (stale→MISSING→OWNER); exact revisions, lease intervals, ownership, dead-ID history.
- **`compiler.py`** — exact-integer witnesses and the plan compiler: capacity witnesses over lease breakpoints; deficient-cut witnesses via min-cut (cross-checked against brute force on random instances); tight-cut analysis feeding sound structural constraints and residual pruning; a backtracking, constraint-aware, randomized tree/route search over weighted logical trees with hash-consed serial-route recipe circuits (concat joins only at forwarders); and a full independent plan verifier.

**Validation**: hand-computed semantic tests, JSON/UTF-8 edge cases, ~2000 randomized traces with independent certificate checking (every `denied`/`blocked` witness and every `prepared` plan re-verified), compiler fuzzing against the exact cut characterization (including adversarially budget-tightened instances through 24–32 participants), and max-schema-size traces (48 vertices, 128 links, 32 participants, 10^12 demands) compiling in ~3 s against the 60 s budget.
